issues.title: WIN-006: detail_verdict_text missing centuries-averaged gufm1 cross-check (1590-1990 scale; dome 2.8× too fast on its own timescale)
issues.description: WIN-006.c7 review (2026-06-23T05:14Z) flags that detail_verdict_text compares 0.0466 deg/yr against 10-15 km/yr recent-decades rate but does NOT include the gufm1 centuries-averaged cross-check. gufm1+IGRF gives ~729 km / 400 yr = ~1.82 km/yr (~0.0164 deg/yr), so dome's 0.0466 deg/yr is ~2.8× the actual 1590-1990 centuries-averaged rate — the regression-slope match fails on the dome's own preferred timescale. This is the c5+c6 stronger_arg promoted to hole in c7 after 4 cycles of non-implementation. Also add 1-clause to tldr_verdict.
